anomalies.observed: The P-MOSFET Q1 has its gate on Net-(Q1-G) connected only to C3 pin 2 and Q2 collector. There is no pull-up resistor from the gate to VCC (source).
anomalies.expected: A pull-up resistor (e.g., 10 kΩ) between Q1 gate and VCC is required to turn Q1 off when Q2 is off. Without it, the gate floats and Q1 cannot be reliably turned off.
anomalies.impact: Q1 will not turn off when Q2 is off; the fan will remain powered continuously, defeating PWM control.

anomalies.observed: C2 is a 100 nF capacitor on the +5V output of the LM1117-5.0 regulator.
anomalies.expected: The LM1117 datasheet requires a minimum output capacitance of 10 µF (tantalum or aluminum electrolytic) for stability. C2 should be 10 µF, not 100 nF.
anomalies.impact: The 5V rail may oscillate or be unstable, potentially causing erratic operation of the ATtiny microcontrollers and other 5V logic.

parsed.summary: The design contains two significant anomalies: a missing pull-up resistor on the P-MOSFET gate (Q1) that prevents the fan from turning off, and an undersized output capacitor (C2, 100 nF instead of 10 µF) for the LM1117-5.0 regulator that risks 5V rail instability.
